units.title: Tell what happened
units.description: Build a connected account with scene, event, sequence and outcome.

lessons.title: An event in progress
lessons.outcome: I can say what was happening when one event occurred.
lessons.takeaway: Use imperfetto for the scene in progress and passato prossimo for a bounded event in conversational narration.

targets.label: Place a background action and an event on one timeline
targets.explanation: The imperfetto presents an action already underway; the passato prossimo marks the event that happened during it.

repair.title: Which action was already underway?
repair.body: Locate the action in progress first. Put that scene in the imperfetto; put the new bounded event in the passato prossimo.

examples.it: Leggevo quando è arrivata Sara.
examples.en: I was reading when Sara arrived.

steps.title: Words for a short story
steps.body: Read and hear these everyday actions before choosing a past form.

steps.title: Show the scene already in progress
steps.body: Preparavo is imperfetto. It presents dinner preparation as an action underway in the past; it does not say when it finished.

examples.it: Alle sette preparavo la cena.
examples.en: At seven I was preparing dinner.

steps.prompt: The dinner preparation was already in progress. Choose its form.
steps.context: Alle sette ___ la cena.
steps.translation: At seven I was preparing dinner.
steps.explanation: Preparavo puts the reader inside an action that was underway at seven.
steps.hint: The model above uses preparavo for an action in progress.
steps.speak: Alle sette preparavo la cena.

steps.title: Add the event that happened
steps.body: The arrival is a bounded event during that scene. In conversational narration, use passato prossimo for the arrival.

examples.it: Preparavo la cena quando è arrivata Sara.
examples.en: I was preparing dinner when Sara arrived.

steps.prompt: Sara's arrival is the bounded event. Choose its form.
steps.context: Preparavo la cena quando Sara ___ .
steps.translation: I was preparing dinner when Sara arrived.
steps.explanation: È arrivata marks one completed arrival; Sara gives the feminine agreement.
steps.hint: Use the full conversational passato prossimo form shown in the model.
steps.speak: Preparavo la cena quando Sara è arrivata.

steps.title: Listen to the whole account
steps.it: Ieri preparavo la cena. Sara è arrivata alle sette. Poi abbiamo mangiato insieme.
steps.en: Yesterday I was preparing dinner. Sara arrived at seven. Then we ate together.
steps.task: Notice the action already underway and the later arrival.

steps.prompt: Choose the ongoing background action.
steps.context: Alle otto Luca ___ in cucina; poi è squillato il telefono.
steps.translation: At eight Luca was cooking in the kitchen; then the phone rang.
steps.explanation: Cucinava describes Luca's action already underway when the phone rang.
steps.hint: The English 'was cooking' marks an action underway.
steps.speak: Alle otto Luca cucinava in cucina; poi è squillato il telefono.

steps.prompt: Complete with the conversational passato prossimo of arrivare for Anna.
steps.context: Mentre leggevo, Anna ___ a casa.
steps.translation: While I was reading, Anna arrived home.
steps.explanation: Anna's one arrival is the bounded event; arrivare takes essere and feminine agreement here.
steps.hint: Use è plus the feminine participle of arrivare.
steps.speak: Mentre leggevo, Anna è arrivata a casa.

steps.prompt: Complete with the imperfetto of preparare for noi.
steps.context: Mentre fuori pioveva, noi ___ la cena.
steps.translation: While it was raining outside, we were preparing dinner.
steps.explanation: Preparavamo puts our dinner preparation in progress during the rain.
steps.hint: The noi imperfetto ending of -are verbs is -avamo.
steps.speak: Mentre fuori pioveva, noi preparavamo la cena.

steps.prompt: Build the short account of an action interrupted by a phone call.

steps.hint: Start with the action that was already underway.

steps.title: A note after a delay
steps.it: Ieri ho preso l’autobus per andare al cinema. Dopo dieci minuti il mezzo si è fermato nel traffico. Per questo sono arrivata tardi e ho perso l’inizio del film. Ho scritto a Elena per avvisarla; alla fine ci siamo incontrate davanti all’uscita.

steps.title: Museum and guide notices
steps.it:
Museo Civico — Sabato il museo apre alle nove. La visita guidata comincia alle nove e trenta davanti all’ingresso principale e dura circa un’ora. I biglietti nominativi vengono controllati all’ingresso; chi ha prenotato online deve mostrare il biglietto sul telefono o stampato. Nelle gallerie si possono fare fotografie senza flash. Se piove, soltanto la visita del giardino viene rimandata a domenica; le gallerie interne restano aperte sabato.
Guida Marta — Per favore, confermate la vostra presenza per email entro giovedì alle diciotto. Se non potete venire, avvisatemi: potrò offrire il posto a un’altra persona. Vi risponderò venerdì con il punto d’incontro definitivo. Il messaggio non dice nulla su eventuali rimborsi.
steps.en:
Civic Museum — On Saturday the museum opens at nine. The guided tour begins at 9:30 in front of the main entrance and lasts about an hour. Named tickets are checked at the entrance; online bookers must show the ticket on a phone or in print. Photographs without flash are allowed in the galleries. If it rains, only the garden tour is postponed to Sunday; the indoor galleries remain open Saturday.
Guide Marta — Please confirm attendance by email by Thursday at six in the evening. If you cannot come, let me know so I can offer the place to someone else. I will reply Friday with the final meeting point. The message says nothing about refunds.
steps.task: Find the exact times, entry rule, rain condition and requested reply.
